Endpoint velocity is measured at sampled frames; continuous derivatives alone are not proof.
No foot locking, floor, partner-contact or obstacle solve.

observer_motion.method: whole inactive span easing; length-preserving torso/arm rotations; attention to active roots
limitations: Authored observation, not generated contextual acting or a learned idle model.
No stepping or lower-body weight transfer; existing foot positions remain exact.
No finger, eye or palm contact solve; positional head motion is not eye gaze.
Arm relaxation can change body clearance; caller must check final scene and cast geometry.
Exact reentry endpoints can require anticipatory return toward the incoming pose.

motion_refinement.body_clearance_proxy: named joint and limb midpoint spheres, all frames; intended contact excluded

observer_continuations.source: independent ARDY Core observer turn; authored boundary bridge

spans.display_processing: native anatomy direction fit; linear 20 to 30fps interpolation

motion.native_history_policy: Only actual prior Core native330 features; no InterGen conversion

anatomy.method: Core world bone directions with native actor median segment lengths
anatomy.floor_policy: Preserve source minimum ankle/toe height with one Y-only root translation each frame.
limitations: Core wrist and elbow endpoints move as part of this explicit morphology retarget.
No FK from the old 17-bone rig and no InterGen-to-Core conversion.
Core foot sliding is not repaired; ground contact and mesh penetration remain unverified.
Native source lengths vary while Core display lengths use actor-specific medians.
